import awkward as ak
from pocket_coffea.lib.processor import BaseProcessor


class DimuonAnalysis(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis using PocketCoffea framework."""
    
    def process_objects(self, df):
        """
        Object preselection hook: create MuonGood collection.
        Selects muons with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4.
        """
        muon_mask = (df["Muon"]["pt"] > 15) & (ak.fill_none(ak.abs(df["Muon"]["eta"]), 999) < 2.4)
        df["MuonGood"] = df["Muon"][muon_mask]
        return df
    
    def count_objects(self, df):
        """
        Object-counting hook: store number of selected muons per event.
        """
        df["n_muons"] = ak.count(df["MuonGood"].pt, axis=1)
        return df

    """Minimal dimuon analysis using PocketCoffea framework."""
    
    def process_objects(self, df):
        """
        Object preselection hook: create MuonGood collection.
        Selects muons with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4.
        """
        muon_mask = (df["Muon"]["pt"] > 15) & (ak.fill_none(ak.abs(df["Muon"]["eta"]), 999) < 2.4)
        df["MuonGood"] = df["Muon"][muon_mask]
        return df
    
    def count_objects(self, df):
        """
        Object-counting hook: store number of selected muons per event.
